Please guide me and tell me what is the reason, otherwise I will get mad, and will get severly depressed. For God's sake answer me, as soon as possible. Question: Assalam U Alaikum! I am not having words and courage to explain my feelings and my emotions, to explain this problem with you, but this happend to me twice. Well, I am a Muslim/Sunni, I am not a good practicing muslim, but I have a strong faith in God/Prophet and Quran. I curse my self for not being a good and practicing muslim. Well, my problem is I saw in my dreams doing sex with my real mother, who has died almost 5 years ago. I am extremly worried, depressed and don't understand what to do? I can't even want to remind it even in my own mind. But what is going wrong that I see such Nasty, shameful and mean kind of dreams. Please guide me and tell me what is the reason, otherwise I will get mad, and will get severly depressed. For God's sake answer me, as soon as possible. Answer ID: 21711 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 899/689/H=1431) Whatever ferocity and fear you are feeling from the external appearance of the dream is natural. The dream means that insha-Allah you will be graced with the visit of Harmain Sharifain (the two holy Mosques, may Almighty Allah increase their honour, dignity, glory and prestige). In order to remove the fear visit the grave of your late mother and regularly send her rewards extensively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
